product.description: Hannah și l-a dorit dintotdeauna pe Oscar, iar micuțul dalmațian e foarte atașat de ea și ar vrea să stea impreună toată ziua. # Oscar se simte singur by Litera: An Engaging Read for Young Learners

Discover the heartwarming story of *Oscar se simte singur* (Oscar Feels Lonely), a charming book from Litera perfect for young readers. This title not only captures the emotional journey of friendship but also serves as an excellent tool for early literacy development, making reading fun and accessible for children starting their academic journey.

When Hannah first acquired Oscar, the little Dalmatian became deeply attached to her. He wishes to spend every day by her side. However, preparations for school play rehearsals keep keeping Hannah busy, leaving less time for walks with him. As days pass, Oscar begins to feel overlooked and lonely. The story explores a universal concern: does Hannah still want to spend time with him?
